t_advice_summary_textbox.text: They said to look for the pattern related to color, side of the screen, and height of the gnome. Once I find one that consistently scores higher, I should continue picking that gnome

vb_textbox.text: Pay attention to the different patterns: color of gnome hat, gnome height, the side of the screen the gnome is on. Certain colors earn more points depending on the side the gnome is standing. So it is not solely based on color, but color and side. As in a yellow hat gnome can earn a lot of points on one side but on the other side they earn none or very little.
